Write code that flags or redacts unsafe spans from text using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: Amazon Comprehend / Bedrock Guardrails
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: detect_toxic_content, apply_guardrail
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/comprehend/latest/dg/trust-safety.html

  SDK: alibabacloud_green
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: text/scan
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/331920.html

  Interface: rest
  Documented operations: comments:analyze
  Setup hints: PERSPECTIVE_API_KEY

  Interface: rest

  Setup hints: TISANE_API_KEY

  SDK: ibm-watsonx-ai / REST
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: HAP detection, text detection
  Setup hints: WATSONX_API_KEY, WATSONX_PROJECT_ID
  Official docs: https://www.ibm.com/docs/en/watsonxdata/premium/2.3.x?topic=prompts-removing-harmful-content

  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: analyze_text
  Setup hints: AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT, AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/content-safety/overview

output_text:
```python
import os
from azure.ai.contentsafety import ContentSafetyClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
from azure.ai.contentsafety.models import AnalyzeTextOptions, TextCategory

def flag_or_redact_unsafe_text(text: str, redact: bool = False) -> dict:
    """
    Flags or redacts unsafe spans in text using Azure AI Content Safety.

    Args:
        text: Input text to analyze.
        redact: If True, returns redacted text with unsafe spans replaced by '[REDACTED]'.
                If False, returns original text with flagged spans and their categories.

    Returns:
        dict: {
            "is_safe": bool,
            "categories": list of str (if unsafe),
            "flagged_spans": list of dict (if unsafe and not redact),
            "redacted_text": str (if redact and unsafe)
        }
    """
    endpoint = os.getenv("AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_ENDPOINT")
    key = os.getenv("AZURE_CONTENT_SAFETY_KEY")

    if not endpoint or not key:
        raise ValueError("Azure Content Safety endpoint and key must be set in environment variables.")

    client = ContentSafetyClient(endpoint, AzureKeyCredential(key))

    request = AnalyzeTextOptions(text=text, categories=[
        TextCategory.HATE,
        TextCategory.SELF_HARM,
        TextCategory.SEXUAL,
        TextCategory.VIOLENCE
    ])

    response = client.analyze_text(request)

    result = {"is_safe": True}

    if response.hate_result.severity > 0 or \
       response.self_harm_result.severity > 0 or \
       response.sexual_result.severity > 0 or \
       response.violence_result.severity > 0:

        result["is_safe"] = False
        categories = []
        flagged_spans = []

        if response.hate_result.severity > 0:
            categories.append("hate")
            for span in response.hate_result.flagged_text:
                flagged_spans.append({
                    "text": span.text,
                    "category": "hate",
                    "offset": span.offset,
                    "length": span.length
                })

        if response.self_harm_result.severity > 0:
            categories.append("self_harm")
            for span in response.self_harm_result.flagged_text:
                flagged_spans.append({
                    "text": span.text,
                    "category": "self_harm",
                    "offset": span.offset,
                    "length": span.length
                })

        if response.sexual_result.severity > 0:
            categories.append("sexual")
            for span in response.sexual_result.flagged_text:
                flagged_spans.append({
                    "text": span.text,
                    "category": "sexual",
                    "offset": span.offset,
                    "length": span.length
                })

        if response.violence_result.severity > 0:
            categories.append("violence")
            for span in response.violence_result.flagged_text:
                flagged_spans.append({
                    "text": span.text,
                    "category": "violence",
                    "offset": span.offset,
                    "length": span.length
                })

        result["categories"] = list(set(categories))

        if redact:
            redacted_text = list(text)
            for span in sorted(flagged_spans, key=lambda x: x["offset"], reverse=True):
                start = span["offset"]
                end = start + span["length"]
                redacted_text[start:end] = "[REDACTED]"
            result["redacted_text"] = "".join(redacted_text)
        else:
            result["flagged_spans"] = flagged_spans

    return result
```
